Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

magenta 1.5.0

  • Severe malaria: acquired and maternal severe immunity (IVA, IVM) as in Griffin et al. 2015, Severe and Severe_05 loggers, and severe_rates() and severe_outcomes().
  • Infection, immunity boosting, maternal immunity and mosquito biting brought in line with malariasimulation (see the Equivalence vignette). This changes model outputs.
  • Run from Imperial’s malariasimulation site files with site_to_pipeline(), site_ft() and site_seasonality() (see the “Running from a site file” vignette). Only treatment, bed nets and IRS are used.
  • pipeline() and equilibrium_init_create() take seasonality directly.
  • New itn_decay_clock in model_param_list_create(): “breakpoint” (the default, as before), “campaign” or “constant”.
  • drug_create() and the drug_create_*() functions are exported.

Behaviour changes and bug fixes:

  • itn_half_life and irs_half_life now take effect (defaults unchanged).
  • Non-malarial fevers in uninfected people only give drugs to those who seek treatment (ft).
  • ft = 0 no longer runs as ft = Inf.
  • Q0, mu0 and the infection and immunity parameters are now read by the individual model on a fresh start, not only from saved states.
  • A seasonality argument now reaches the individual model.
  • Initially infected people can realise new infections, and ICM_init is kept in saved states.

magenta 1.3.8

  • New vignettes: Loggers, DrugStrategies and NewDrugs. Resistance and Introduction rewritten, and vignette sources moved to vignettes_src/.
  • Bug fix to initialisation that caused resistance simulations to crash during the LPF calculation.
  • Bug fix to the asymptomatic discount in the LPF calculation, which was computed with integer arithmetic and so never applied.
  • Gametocyte sterilisation now applies to artemisinin sensitive strains, as documented, rather than resistant ones.

magenta 1.3.7

  • Fix to saved state initialisation of barcode bitset sizing on Windows

magenta 1.3.6

  • Reloading models saved to file working again
  • New function update_saved_state_barcode_plaf to update plaf in saved simulation

magenta 1.3.5

  • Seasonality patch so that admin and country name specification to pipeline correctly creates seasonal simulations.

magenta 1.3.4

  • Non-malarial fevers were not going through correct drug allocation so could not track who was getting what drug when it was an NMF.

magenta 1.3.3

  • Prophylaxis fixes. Individuals who failed treatment and recrudesce were not getting full duration of prophylaxis previously (short by a couple days)

magenta 1.3.2

  • NMF fixes. Individuals not infected who are treated due to NMF go straight to an elongated prophylaxis.

magenta 1.3.1

  • Importations can have same barcode as PLAF via island_imports_plaf_linked_flag

magenta 1.3.0

  • Major changes inplace for simulating resistance

magenta 1.2.0

  • Documentation for base model
  • dde::dopri fix that caused deterministic model to fail below very small EIR

magenta 1.1.0

  • New param_list_simulation_finalizer_create used within pipeline to return Rcpp memory

magenta 1.0.0

  • New major version for stable base model for publication. Versioning now incremental.
  • New version fixes minor changes to historic strain clearing in resistance
